summary: Completed comprehensive re-testing of SignalForge AI Crypto Trading Platform after 3 critical fixes. All 3 fixes verified successfully: (1) Paper Trading BUY button now clickable and functional, (2) Sign out properly redirects to /landing, (3) 401 handling correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login. All regression tests passed including landing page, login, dashboard, AI signals (Claude & Gemini), coin detail charts, and backtesting. Frontend: 100% success rate (9/9 tests passed).
